arxiv-2304-05676.title: Mathematical derivation of wave propagation properties in hierarchical neural networks with predictive coding feedback dynamics
arxiv-2304-05676.creator: Grégory Faye, Guilhem Fouilhé, Rufin VanRullen
arxiv-2304-05676.description: Abstract Sensory perception (e.g. vision) relies on a hierarchy of cortical areas, in which neural activity propagates in both directions, to convey information not only about sensory inputs but also about cognitive states, expectations and predictions. At the macroscopic scale, neurophysiological experiments have described the corresponding neural signals as both forward and backward-travelling waves, sometimes with characteristic oscillatory signatures.

arxiv-2304-07209.creator: M. Farasat Shamir, Mushtaq Ahmad, G. Mustafa, Aisha Rashid

arxiv-2312-11302.title: AFDM-SCMA: A Promising Waveform for Massive Connectivity over High Mobility Channels Thanks: Qu Luo and Pei Xiao are with the 5G & 6G Innovation Centre, University of Surrey, U. K. (email: {q.u.luo, p.xiao}@surrey.ac.uk). Zilong Liu and Thomos, Nikolaos are with the School of Computer Science and El
arxiv-2312-11302.creator: Qu Luo, Pei Xiao, Zilong Liu
arxiv-2312-11302.description: Abstract This paper studies the affine frequency division multiplexing (AFDM)-empowered sparse code multiple access (SCMA) system, referred to as AFDM-SCMA, for supporting massive connectivity in high-mobility environments. First, by placing the sparse codewords on the AFDM chirp subcarriers, the input-output (I/O) relation of AFDM-SCMA systems is presented.

arxiv-2403-12302.title: A 2 2 -distance ( 2 ​ Δ + 7 ) (2\Delta+7) -coloring of planar graphs
arxiv-2403-12302.creator: Zakir Deniz
arxiv-2403-12302.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Zakir Deniz. A vertex coloring of a graph G G is called a 2 2 -distance coloring if any two vertices at a distance at most 2 2 from each other receive different colors. Recently, Bousquet et al. (Discrete Mathematics, 346(4), 113288, 2023) proved that 2 ​ Δ + 7 2\Delta+7 colors are sufficient for the 2 2 -distance coloring of planar graphs with maximum degree Δ ≥ 9 \Delta\geq 9 .

arxiv-2407-05940.title: Some Novel Results on ( α , β ) (\alpha,\beta) -Ricci-Yamabe Soliton and its Spacetime
arxiv-2407-05940.description: Abstract Abstract: This article aims to investigate the characteristics of (\alpha,\beta) -Ricci-Yamabe Soliton (briefly: (\alpha,\beta)-(RYS)_{n} ) and its spacetime. The inclusion of killing vector field and the Lorentzian metrics make the Ricci-Yamabe soliton richer and interesting. We study the cosmological and dust fluid model on (RYS)_{4} equipped with Lorentzian para Sasakian (LPS)_{4} spacetime.

arxiv-2407-19084.title: Propeller Modulation Equalization via Reference Tones
arxiv-2407-19084.creator: Mostafa Ibrahim, Sabit Ekin
arxiv-2407-19084.description: Abstract Propeller modulation, also known as micro-Doppler modulation, presents a significant challenge in radio frequency (RF) inspection operations conducted via drones. This paper investigates the equalization of propeller modulation effects on RF signals, specifically targeting applications in navigation aids such as Instrument Landing Systems (ILS).

arxiv-2409-04549.title: Two-Sided Lossless Expanders in the Unbalanced Setting
arxiv-2409-04549.creator: Eshan Chattopadhyay, Mohit Gurumukhani, Noam Ringach, Yunya Zhao
arxiv-2409-04549.description: Abstract We present the first explicit construction of two-sided lossless expanders in the unbalanced setting (bipartite graphs that have polynomially many more nodes on the left than on the right). Prior to our work, all known explicit constructions in the unbalanced setting achieved only one-sided lossless expansion.

arxiv-2504-16379.title: SplitReason: Learning To Offload Reasoning
arxiv-2504-16379.creator: Yash Akhauri, Anthony Fei, Chi - Chih Chang, Yueying Li, Mohamed S. Abdelfattah
arxiv-2504-16379.description: Abstract Reasoning in large language models (LLMs) tends to produce substantially longer token generation sequences than simpler language modeling tasks. This extended generation length reflects the multi-step, compositional nature of reasoning and is often correlated with higher solution accuracy. From an efficiency perspective, longer token generation exacerbates the inherently sequential and memory-bound decoding phase of LLMs.

arxiv-2505-15528.title: PlantDreamer: Achieving Realistic 3D Plant Models with Diffusion-Guided Gaussian Splatting
arxiv-2505-15528.creator: Zane K J Hartley † \dagger, Lewis A G Stuart † \dagger, Andrew P French, Michael P Pound, School of Computer Science, University of Nottingham, Wollaton Road, NG8 1BB
arxiv-2505-15528.description: Abstract Recent years have seen substantial improvements in the ability to generate synthetic 3D objects using AI. However, generating complex 3D objects, such as plants, remains a considerable challenge. Current generative 3D models struggle with plant generation compared to general objects, limiting their usability in plant analysis tools, which require fine detail and accurate geometry.

arxiv-2507-06953.title: On the Borel complexity of the space of left-orderings of nilpotent groups
arxiv-2507-06953.creator: Emir Molina Taucán
arxiv-2507-06953.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Emir Molina Taucán. \useleadsheetslibraries musicsymbols Abstract We give the first examples of nonabelian left-orderable groups such that the conjugacy orbit equivalence relation on its space of orders has infinity orbits, yet it is smooth in the Borel sense. The examples are all nilpotent groups and we provide a sufficient condition so that the space of orders of a nilpotent group has a smooth conjugacy orbit relation. We also show with different examples that nilpotence is not a sufficient condition for smoothness.

arxiv-2508-11280.title: LETToT: Label-Free Evaluation of Large Language Models On Tourism Using Expert Tree-of-Thought
arxiv-2508-11280.creator: Ruiyan Qi, Congding Wen, Weibo Zhou, Jiwei Li, Shangsong Liang, Lingbo Li
arxiv-2508-11280.description: Abstract Evaluating large language models (LLMs) in specific domain like tourism remains challenging due to the prohibitive cost of annotated benchmarks and persistent issues like hallucinations. We propose L abel-Free E valuation of LLM on T ourism using Expert T ree- o f- T hought (LETToT), a framework that leverages expert-derived reasoning structures—instead of labeled data—to assess LLMs in tourism.

arxiv-2508-19617.title: Fractional domatic number and minimum degree
arxiv-2508-19617.creator: Quentin Chuet, Hugo Demaret, Hoang La, François Pirot
arxiv-2508-19617.description: Abstract The domatic number of a graph G G is the maximum number of pairwise disjoint dominating sets of G G . We are interested in the LP-relaxation of this parameter, which is called the fractional domatic number of G G . We study its extremal value in the class of graphs of minimum degree d d .

arxiv-2510-15034.title: Reconstructing Spin Hamiltonians of 2D Gutzwiller-Projected Wavefunctions
arxiv-2510-15034.creator: Lucas Z. Brito, J. B. Marston
arxiv-2510-15034.description: Abstract We apply the correlation matrix Hamiltonian reconstruction technique to the two-dimensional Gutzwiller-projected Fermi sea and π \pi -flux states on finite-sized square and triangular lattices. Our results indicate no spin Hamiltonian with simple local interaction terms stabilizes such states for finite system sizes.

arxiv-2512-11960.title: Cosmic Duets I.
arxiv-2512-11960.creator: M. Scialpi, F. Mannucci, Q. D’Amato, C. Marconcini, G. Cresci, A. Marconi, L. Ulivi, M. Fumagalli, P. Rosati, G. Tozzi, M.V. Zanchettin, E. Cataldi, L. Battistini, E. Bertola, C. Bracci, S. Carniani, M. Ceci, A. Chakraborty, C. Cicone, A. Ciurlo, A. De Rosa, G. Di Rosa, A. Feltre, M. Ginolfi, I. Lam
arxiv-2512-11960.description: Abstract We present the first-year results of the MUSE Large Program “Cosmic Duets”, aimed at obtaining adaptive-optics assisted MUSE observations with a typical angular resolution of 0.1 ′′ − 0.2 ′′ 0.1^{\prime\prime}-0.2^{\prime\prime} , providing integral-field spectroscopy of sub-arcsec separation dual and lensed active galactic nuclei (AGN) candidates.

arxiv-2601-22631.title: PEFT-MuTS: A Multivariate Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning Framework for Remaining Useful Life Prediction based on Cross-domain Time Series Representation Model
arxiv-2601-22631.creator: En Fu, Yanyan Hu, Changhua Hu, Zengwang Jin, Kaixiang Peng
arxiv-2601-22631.description: Abstract The application of data-driven remaining useful life (RUL) prediction has long been constrained by the availability of large amount of degradation data. Mainstream solutions such as domain adaptation and meta-learning still rely on large amounts of historical degradation data from equipment that is identical or similar to the target, which imposes significant limitations in practical applications.

openalex-w2162584119.creator: Jens Kattge, S. DÍAZ, Sandra Lavorel, Iain Colin Prentice, Paul Leadley, Gerhard Bönisch, Éric Garnier, Mark Westoby, Peter B. Reich, Ian J. Wright, J. H. C. Cornelissen, Cyrille Violle
openalex-w2162584119.description: Abstract Plant traits – the morphological, anatomical, physiological, biochemical and phenological characteristics of plants and their organs – determine how primary producers respond to environmental factors, affect other trophic levels, influence ecosystem processes and...

pmc-11454531.title: 6569 An Increase, Rather Than Absolute Amount, Of Corticotropin-Releasing Hormone (Crh) Drives Mouse Anxiety-Like Behavior
pmc-11454531.creator: Hannah Rose Friedman, Lindsey Gaston, Li Chan, Joseph A Majzoub
pmc-11454531.description: Disclosure: H.R. Friedman: None. L. Gaston: None. L. Chan: None. J.A. Majzoub: None.Approximately 300 million people have an anxiety disorder. We previously found that anxiety-like behavior (AB) is decreased in mice which lack hypothalamic (HT) Crh (1), so we hypothesized that increased HT Crh, due to primary adrenal insufficiency (PAI), would induce increased AB.

pmc-11692711.title: A CHALLENGE HONORING SELF-DETERMINATION OF NURSING HOME RESIDENTS WITH DEMENTIA; WHICH SELF -- THEN SELF OR NOW SELF?
pmc-11692711.creator: Mercedes Bern-Klug, Meredith Levine
pmc-11692711.description: Medicare and/or Medicaid certified nursing homes (NHs) are required to inform residents they have a right to an advance directive. The government’s Resident Rights requires staff to honor resident self-determination. What happens when instructions in an advance directive are in opposition to the current expressed requests of a person with advanced dementia?

pmc-11848369.title: BASELINE CLINICAL CHARACTERISTICS OF CONTEMPORARY ADULT CHRONIC RHEUMATIC HEART DISEASE IN IBADAN, NIGERIA
pmc-11848369.creator: OS Ogah, AT Adeyanju, EP Iyawe, KF Okwunze, M Okeke, AC Ugah, CA Nwamadiegesi, FE Obiekwe, TK Afolabi, OV Adeyeye, CH Ezeh, A Aje, A Adebiyi
pmc-11848369.description: Introduction:Introduction: Rheumatic heart disease (RHD) is a major public health issue, especially in developing countries. Globally, the largest increase in RHD incidence over 30 years was seen in sub-Saharan Africa, further contributing to the burden of cardiovascular disease in a region with high rates of hypertensive heart disease and cardiomyopathies.

pmc-12649738.title: Understanding Attorneys’ Plea Advice: The Role of Defendant Guilt and Trial Penalties
pmc-12649738.creator: Janice L Burke, Miko M Wilford, Yueran Yang, Justin Bonny
pmc-12649738.description: Plea bargaining underlies the majority of criminal convictions in the United States, yet concerns remain about its potentially coercive effects, particularly when sentencing differentials between plea offers and potential trial outcomes are large. This experiment examined practicing attorneys’ plea-related recommendations in a 2 (Defendant guilt status: guilty or innocent) × 3 (Potential trial sentence: low, moderate, or high) between-subjects design.

pmc-12741139.title: Proposal for a new conceptual framework to guide early intervention professionals in a transcultural context
pmc-12741139.creator: Berna Elias, Aline Bogossian
pmc-12741139.description: BackgroundParental engagement in early intervention programs for children with neurodevelopmental conditions is complex, particularly within transcultural contexts. This study examines current models of parental engagement to identify key factors that support inclusive approaches and to develop a flexible framework that addresses the realities of immigrant families raising children with neurodevelopmental conditions in transcultural settings.

pmc-12752430.title: Interpretable machine learning approach for optimizing hospice care predictions using health assessment data
pmc-12752430.creator: Shih-Yu Cho, Wei-Shu Lai, Jui-Hung Tsai, Peng-Chan Lin, Hsin-Hung Chou
pmc-12752430.description: BackgroundDetermining the appropriate end-of-life (EOL) care model within a short time frame is challenging and requires extensive experience. To the best of our knowledge, no studies have developed automatic systems for identifying the hospice care models: hospice home (HHC), inpatient (HIC), and shared care (HSC).

pmc-12883020.title: Mixed-phenotype acute leukemia with trilineage differentiation presenting as a non-leukemic mediastinal tumor
pmc-12883020.creator: Satoshi Ichikawa, Maya Yamato, Shusuke Hatta, Koichi Onodera, Noriko Fukuhara, Ryo Ichinohasama, Hideo Harigae
pmc-12883020.description: Mixed-phenotype acute leukemia (MPAL) is an uncommon hematological malignancy, and cases exhibiting trilineage differentiation are extraordinarily rare. Here, we report the case of a 63-year-old male patient who presented with severe dyspnea secondary to a massive anterior mediastinal mass and pleural effusion, in the absence of detectable abnormal cells in the peripheral blood.

pmc-13071859.title: Predictors of Massive Transfusion in Patients With Hollow Organ Injury After Blunt Multiple Trauma: A Cohort of Blunt Bowel Mesenteric Injury
pmc-13071859.creator: Ting-Min Hsieh, Po-Chun Chuang, Chun-Ting Liu, Bei-Yu Wu, Ching-Hua Hsieh, Fu-Jen Cheng, Shashank Kaushik
pmc-13071859.description: BackgroundMassive transfusion (MT) is life‐saving for patients with exsanguination, especially after blunt abdominopelvic trauma, due to subtle manifestations. Blunt bowel mesenteric injuries (BBMIs), besides their potential risk of peritonitis, are still one of the few indications for emergency laparotomy for hemorrhagic shock in the era of nonoperative management.

pmc-13247539.title: Preclinical and Virtual Models of Mucosal Melanoma: Bridging Translational Gaps in a Rare and Lethal Cancer
pmc-13247539.creator: Xiangjie Jin, Yuhan Zhang, Yuantai Zhu, Zhiyuan Zhang, Chaoji Shi
pmc-13247539.description: Mucosal melanoma (MM) is a rare and lethal subtype of melanoma, disproportionately affecting Asian populations and exhibiting distinct clinicopathological and genetic features compared to cutaneous melanoma (CM). Often diagnosed at advanced stages, MM shows poor responses to conventional therapies, and no standardized treatment regimen currently exists.

pmc-13341563.title: The CHRNA5 rs16969968 variant is associated with MMP-9 expression and inflammatory signaling in COPD in a West Bengal population, India
pmc-13341563.creator: Himani Adhikari, Nasima Sultana, Achintya Mohan Goswami, Indranil Ganai, Himani Biswas, Amalesh Mondal, Asif Iqbal, Saibal Moitra, Sanjoy Podder

pmc-13529642.title: Remote sEnsing obServations of source Parameters and data IntegRation at EtnA: the RESPIRA database
pmc-13529642.creator: Luigi Mereu, Simona Scollo
pmc-13529642.description: Eruption Source Parameters (ESPs) are fundamental for quantifying paroxysm episodes and are essential inputs for volcanic ash dispersal models used to forecast tephra fallout and assess associated hazard. This is particularly crucial for densely populated regions like Mount Etna, Italy. Since 1986, approximately 150 Etna paroxysm episodes have been monitored using different sensors to estimate these ESPs.

pmc-13651015.title: Spontaneous natural conception and live birth in three patients with likely pathogenic variants in TUBB8, ZP2, and ZP3 associated with female subfertility
pmc-13651015.creator: Juepu Zhou, Hui He, Ruolin Mao, Meng Wang, Rui Long, Xiangfei Wang, Hong Chen, Lei Jin, Lixia Zhu
pmc-13651015.description: CaseThree patients with genetically confirmed female subfertility due to heterozygous likely pathogenic variants in TUBB8 (c.613G > A), ZP2 (c.1421T > C), or ZP3 (c.518 C > G), respectively, had histories of recurrent adverse assisted reproductive technology (ART) outcomes, including zona pellucida (ZP) abnormalities or oocyte degeneration, reduced fertilization, poor embryo development or limited viable embryo availability, and implantation failure.
